spans.s: or बाळ्ह॑, mfn. (√ बंह्; cf. Pāṇ. v, 3, 63) strong, mighty (only ibc. and in बाळ्हे॑ ind.), loudly, strongly, mightily, RV.;
(बाढम् or वाढम्), ind. assuredly, certainly, indeed, really, by all means, so be it, yes (generally used as a particle of consent, affirmation or confirmation), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
बाढ—विक्रम mfn. of excessive prowess, very powerful or strong, W.
बाढ—सृ॑त्वन् mfn. striding mightily along, RV. i, 122, 10.
